content: All verified: `legacy_export` is gone from `registry()` and the remaining handlers (`ping`, `export_v2`, `stats`) work as before. I kept `stats` since it's only ambiguously noted ("deprecated? see #250") and still in use, while `legacy_export` was the explicitly deprecated one (replaced by `export_v2`).

arguments.summary: Removed the deprecated `legacy_export` handler from `api/handlers.py` — both its function definition and its entry in `_REGISTRY` — so it no longer appears in `registry()`. The `stats` handler was left in place because it is only ambiguously marked ("deprecated? see #250") and still called by clients, whereas `legacy_export` was explicitly deprecated in 1.2 and replaced by `export_v2`. Tests pass and the remaining handlers (`ping`, `export_v2`, `stats`) behave as before.
